description.value: Hot House Pizza is a locally-operated pizza chain with five or more locations across Victoria, BC, including Oak Bay, Gordon Head, Cook Street Village, Victoria West, and UVic campus. They hand-make their crusts and offer a wide range of specialty and custom pizzas, including gluten-free, dairy-free, and soy-cheese options. Fresh slices are available to-go at all locations, making this a quick and flexible refuelling stop for cyclists on many routes across the city.
